```{r Step 4: Create Global Data Tables for Error Logging, Retry Handling, and Master Rotation Tracking}
# Create the global error data table for non-response-based sitemap processing errors
global_error_dt <- data.table(
  domain_id              = integer(),      # Unique ID for the domain
  domain_url             = character(),    # Domain URL
  layer_1_url_id         = integer(),      # Unique ID for the top-level sitemap
  layer_1_url            = character(),    # Top-level sitemap URL
  error_url_id           = integer(),      # ID of the problematic sub-URL (from progression)
  error_url              = character(),    # Sub-sitemap or link that caused the error
  parent_url_id          = integer(),      # ID of the parent sitemap URL
  root_tag               = character(),    # Root tag if known ("urlset", "sitemapindex", "unknown", etc.)
  error_category         = character(),    # Class of error (e.g. "xml_parse_error", "excluded_string", "missing_root_tag", ...)
  processed_flag         = logical(),      # Was this URL marked as processed in progression_dt?
  retry_flag             = logical(),      # Should the entry be retried? 
  timestamp              = as.POSIXct(character()),  # Timestamp of logging
  source_function        = character(),    # Where the error was triggered (e.g. "step_6", "step_8", "step_9")
  status_code            = integer()       # HTTP status if applicable
)

# Create the global master data table for tracking the overall status of each sitemap/domain
global_master_dt <- data.table(
  domain_id              = integer(),      # Unique ID for the domain
  domain_url             = character(),    # Domain URL
  layer_1_url_id         = integer(),      # Unique ID for the sitemap
  layer_1_url            = character(),    # Sitemap URL
  input_processing_status= character(),    # Current status (e.g., "ok", "suspicious", "moved to retry")
  total_request_count    = integer(),      # Tracks requests for an input sitemap
  total_urlsets_scraped  = integer(),      # Tracks total urlsets scraped
  last_checked           = as.POSIXct(character()),  # Timestamp of the last check
  current_user_agent_id  = integer(),      # ID of the currently used User-Agent profile
  processing_flag        = character()     # Indicates processing status of the input
)


cat("Step 4 completed: Global error and master data tables created.\n")
```

```{r Step 5: Defining date-check helper functions:}
# Function: step_5_1_date_check_urlset_func
# This function extracts <lastmod> tags from a URLset XML document,
# converts them to dates, and checks if any date falls within the specified date range.
# It returns a list with a decision ("proceed" or "exclude"), a reason, and a representative detected date.
step_5_1_date_check_urlset_func <- function(xml_doc, ns_map, date_from, date_to) {
  # Extract the text of all <lastmod> tags using the provided namespace map
  step_5_1_lastmods <- xml_find_all(xml_doc, ".//ns:lastmod", ns = ns_map) %>% xml_text()
  # Remove any time portion and convert to Date objects
  step_5_1_lastmod_dates <- as.Date(gsub("T.*", "", step_5_1_lastmods), format = "%Y-%m-%d")
  # Remove NA dates
  step_5_1_lastmod_dates <- step_5_1_lastmod_dates[!is.na(step_5_1_lastmod_dates)]
  
  if (length(step_5_1_lastmod_dates) == 0) {
    return(list(decision = "proceed", reason = "no_lastmod_found", detected_date = NA))
  }
  
  if (any(step_5_1_lastmod_dates >= date_from & step_5_1_lastmod_dates <= date_to)) {
    # Use the minimum date that falls within the range as a representative detected date
    step_5_1_detected_date <- min(step_5_1_lastmod_dates[step_5_1_lastmod_dates >= date_from & step_5_1_lastmod_dates <= date_to])
    return(list(decision = "proceed", reason = "in_range", detected_date = step_5_1_detected_date))
  } else {
    return(list(decision = "exclude", reason = "out_of_range", detected_date = NA))
  }
}

# Function: step_5_2_date_check_link_func
# This function checks a URL string for date patterns using regular expressions.
# It determines whether the detected date (if any) falls within the specified date range.
# It returns a list with a decision, a reason, and the detected date.
step_5_2_date_check_link_func <- function(url, date_from, date_to) {

  step_5_2_url_clean <- tolower(url)

  if (is.null(url) || length(url) != 1 || is.na(url) || !nzchar(url)) {
    return(list(decision = "proceed", reason = "no_date", detected_date = NA, matched_pattern = "none"))
  }

  # valid seperators 
  sep <- "[-_\\/]"
  
  # Year only 
  step_5_2_year_pattern <- "(?<!\\d)((?:19|20)\\d{2})(?!\\d)"
  
  # YYYY<sep>MM<sep>DD
  step_5_2_year_month_day_pattern <- paste0(
    "(?<!\\d)",
    "((?:19|20)\\d{2})", sep,
    "(0[1-9]|1[0-2])",      sep,
    "(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])",
    "(?!\\d)"
  )
  
  # YYYYMMDD compact
  step_5_2_compact_year_month_day_pattern <- "(?<!\\d)((?:19|20)\\d{2})(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])(?!\\d)"
  
  # YYYY<sep>MM
  step_5_2_year_month_pattern <- paste0(
    "(?<!\\d)",
    "((?:19|20)\\d{2})", sep,
    "(0[1-9]|1[0-2])",
    "(?!\\d)"
  )
  
  # YYYYMM compact
  step_5_2_compact_year_month_pattern <- "(?<!\\d)((?:19|20)\\d{2})(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?!\\d)"
  
  # MM<sep>YYYY
  step_5_2_month_year_pattern <- paste0(
    "(?<!\\d)",
    "([1-9]|0[1-9]|1[0-2])", sep,
    "((?:19|20)\\d{2})",
    "(?!\\d)"
  )
  
  # DD<sep>MM<sep>YYYY
  step_5_2_day_month_year_pattern <- paste0(
    "(?<!\\d)",
    "(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])", sep,
    "(0[1-9]|1[0-2])",           sep,
    "((?:19|20)\\d{2})",
    "(?!\\d)"
  )
  
  # DDMMYYYY compact
  step_5_2_compact_day_month_year_pattern <- "(?<!\\d)([0-3][0-9])([0][1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])((?:19|20)\\d{2})(?!\\d)"

  step_5_2_short_months <- c("jan", "feb", "mär", "mae", "mar", "apr", "mai", "may", "jun", "jul", "aug", "sep", "okt", "oct", "nov", "dez", "dec")
  step_5_2_long_months <- c("january", "february", "march", "april", "may", "june", "july", "august", "september", "october", "november", "december",
                            "januar", "februar", "märz", "maerz", "april", "mai", "juni", "juli", "august", "september", "oktober", "november", "dezember")
  step_5_2_all_months_pattern <- paste0("(", paste(c(step_5_2_short_months, step_5_2_long_months), collapse = "|"), ")")

  step_5_2_monthname_year_pattern <- paste0(step_5_2_all_months_pattern, "(20\\d{2}|19\\d{2})")
  step_5_2_year_monthname_pattern <- paste0("(20\\d{2}|19\\d{2})", step_5_2_all_months_pattern)

  start_date <- end_date <- detected_date <- NA
  matched_pattern <- NULL

  # Collect all possible matches with positions
  patterns <- list(
    ymd_sep = step_5_2_year_month_day_pattern,
    ymd_compact = step_5_2_compact_year_month_day_pattern,
    dmy_sep = step_5_2_day_month_year_pattern,
    dmy_compact = step_5_2_compact_day_month_year_pattern,
    month_year = step_5_2_month_year_pattern,
    year_month = step_5_2_year_month_pattern,
    ym_compact = step_5_2_compact_year_month_pattern,
    monthname_year = step_5_2_monthname_year_pattern,
    year_monthname = step_5_2_year_monthname_pattern,
    year_only = step_5_2_year_pattern
  )

  matches <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(patterns), function(name) {
    loc <- str_locate_all(step_5_2_url_clean, patterns[[name]])[[1]]
    if (nrow(loc) > 0) {
      data.frame(pattern = name, start = loc[,1], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
  }))
  
  if (is.null(matches) || nrow(matches) == 0) {
    return(list(
      decision        = "proceed",
      reason          = "no_date",
      detected_date   = as.Date(NA),
      matched_pattern = NA_character_
    ))
  }
  # Choose the first occurrence
  first_match <- matches[which.min(matches$start), ]
  pattern <- first_match$pattern

  # Process based on chosen pattern
  if (pattern == "ymd_sep") {
    parts <- str_match(step_5_2_url_clean, step_5_2_year_month_day_pattern)
    year  <- as.integer(parts[1,2]); month <- as.integer(parts[1,3]); day   <- as.integer(parts[1,4])
    detected_date <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", year, month)); pattern <- "ymd"
    start_date <- detected_date; end_date <- start_date + months(1) - days(1)

  } else if (pattern == "ymd_compact") {
    parts <- str_match(step_5_2_url_clean, step_5_2_compact_year_month_day_pattern)
    year  <- as.integer(parts[1,2]); month <- as.integer(parts[1,3]); day   <- as.integer(parts[1,4])
    detected_date <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", year, month)); pattern <- "ymd_compact"
    start_date <- detected_date; end_date <- start_date + months(1) - days(1)

  } else if (pattern == "dmy_sep") {
    parts <- str_match(step_5_2_url_clean, step_5_2_day_month_year_pattern)
    day   <- as.integer(parts[1,2]); month <- as.integer(parts[1,3]); year  <- as.integer(parts[1,4])
    detected_date <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", year, month)); pattern <- "dmy"
    start_date <- detected_date; end_date <- start_date + months(1) - days(1)

  } else if (pattern == "dmy_compact") {
    parts <- str_match(step_5_2_url_clean, step_5_2_compact_day_month_year_pattern)
    day   <- as.integer(parts[1,2]); month <- as.integer(parts[1,3]); year  <- as.integer(parts[1,4])
    detected_date <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", year, month)); pattern <- "dmy_compact"
    start_date <- detected_date; end_date <- start_date + months(1) - days(1)

  } else if (pattern == "month_year") {
    parts <- str_match(step_5_2_url_clean, step_5_2_month_year_pattern)
    month <- as.integer(parts[1,2]); year  <- as.integer(parts[1,3])
    detected_date <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", year, month)); pattern <- "month_year"
    start_date <- detected_date; end_date <- start_date + months(1) - days(1)

  } else if (pattern == "year_month") {
    parts <- str_match(step_5_2_url_clean, step_5_2_year_month_pattern)
    year  <- as.integer(parts[1,2]); month <- as.integer(parts[1,3])
    detected_date <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", year, month)); pattern <- "ym"
    start_date <- detected_date; end_date <- start_date + months(1) - days(1)

  } else if (pattern == "ym_compact") {
    parts <- str_match(step_5_2_url_clean, step_5_2_compact_year_month_pattern)
    year  <- as.integer(parts[1,2]); month <- as.integer(parts[1,3])
    detected_date <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", year, month)); pattern <- "ym_compact"
    start_date <- detected_date; end_date <- start_date + months(1) - days(1)

  } else if (pattern == "monthname_year") {
    parts <- str_match(step_5_2_url_clean, step_5_2_monthname_year_pattern)
    month_name <- tolower(parts[1,2]); year <- as.integer(parts[1,3])
    month_number <- match(month_name, tolower(c(step_5_2_short_months, step_5_2_long_months)))
    if (month_number > length(step_5_2_short_months)) month_number <- month_number - length(step_5_2_short_months)
    detected_date <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", year, month_number)); pattern <- "monthname_year"
    start_date <- detected_date; end_date <- start_date + months(1) - days(1)

  } else if (pattern == "year_monthname") {
    parts <- str_match(step_5_2_url_clean, step_5_2_year_monthname_pattern)
    year <- as.integer(parts[1,2]); month_name <- tolower(parts[1,3])
    month_number <- match(month_name, tolower(c(step_5_2_short_months, step_5_2_long_months)))
    if (month_number > length(step_5_2_short_months)) month_number <- month_number - length(step_5_2_short_months)
    detected_date <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", year, month_number)); pattern <- "ym_monthname"
    start_date <- detected_date; end_date <- start_date + months(1) - days(1)

  } else if (pattern == "year_only") {
    parts <- str_match(step_5_2_url_clean, step_5_2_year_pattern)
    year <- as.integer(parts[1,2])
    detected_date <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-01-01", year)); pattern <- "year_only"
    start_date <- detected_date; end_date <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-12-31", year))
  }

  # Global range check
  if (start_date <= date_to && end_date >= date_from) {
    return(list(decision = ifelse(pattern == "year_only" && is.na(detected_date), "proceed", "proceed"),
                reason   = ifelse(pattern == "year_only", ifelse(start_date <= date_to && end_date >= date_from, "in_range", "out_of_range"), "in_range"),
                detected_date = detected_date,
                matched_pattern = pattern,
                start_date = start_date,
                end_date = end_date))
  } else {
    return(list(decision = "exclude",
                reason = "out_of_range",
                detected_date = detected_date,
                matched_pattern = pattern,
                start_date = start_date,
                end_date = end_date))
  }
}

cat("Step 5 completed: Date check functions defined.\n")

```



```{r Step 6: Defining sorting functions:}
# Function: step_6_1_grouping_func
# This function takes a data.table of links marked as 'no_date' and attempts to group them into pagination groups based on similar basename patterns.
# If a group has fewer than 10 entries or missing numeric indicators, it is flagged as 'individual'; else a pagination_group and pagination_index are assigned.

step_6_1_grouping_func <- function(step_6_1_links_dt,
                                   domain_id,
                                   domain_url,
                                   layer_1_url_id,
                                   layer_1_url,
                                   parent_url_id) {

  # Extract key and number
  step_6_1_links_dt[, group_key := str_replace(basename(link), "-\\d+(?=\\.xml$)", "")]
  step_6_1_links_dt[, group_num := as.integer(str_extract(basename(link), "\\d+(?=\\.xml$)"))]

  # Init columns
  step_6_1_links_dt[, `:=`(
    pagination_group = NA_character_,
    pagination_index = NA_integer_
  )]

  # Identify valid groups
  group_counts <- step_6_1_links_dt[!is.na(group_num), .N, by = group_key]
  valid_groups <- group_counts[N >= 5, group_key]

  for (g in valid_groups) {
    idx <- which(step_6_1_links_dt$group_key == g)
    ordered_idx <- idx[order(step_6_1_links_dt$group_num[idx])]

    group_links <- step_6_1_links_dt$link[ordered_idx]

    # Update progression for each group member
    for (i in seq_along(group_links)) {
      step_7_1_progression_update(
        domain_id         = domain_id,
        domain_url        = domain_url,
        layer_1_url_id    = layer_1_url_id,
        layer_1_url       = layer_1_url,
        current_url       = group_links[i],
        parent_url_id     = parent_url_id,
        pagination_group  = g,
        pagination_index  = i,
        pagination_group_status = "candidate"
      )
    }
  }
  return(step_6_1_links_dt)
}

step_6_sorting_func <- function(step_6_links_vector, 
                                layer_1_url_id, 
                                layer_1_url,          
                                parent_url, 
                                parent_url_id,
                                global_date_start, 
                                global_date_end, 
                                global_excluded_strings,
                                domain_id = NA_integer_,
                                domain_url = NA_character_) {
  
  prog_name <- paste0("sitemap_id_", layer_1_url_id, "_progression_dt")

  # Initialize internal data.table
  step_6_sort_list_dt <- data.table::data.table(
    link = step_6_links_vector,
    in_range = NA_character_,
    excluded = NA_character_,
    sort_place = NA_integer_,
    pagination_group = NA_character_,
    pagination_index = NA_integer_
  )
  
  # Exclude links containing excluded strings
  excluded_pattern <- paste(global_excluded_strings, collapse = "|")
  step_6_sort_list_dt[stringr::str_detect(link, excluded_pattern), excluded := "by_string"]
  
  # Apply date check on remaining links
  for (i in which(is.na(step_6_sort_list_dt$excluded))) {
    check_result <- step_5_2_date_check_link_func(step_6_sort_list_dt$link[i], global_date_start, global_date_end)
    
    if (check_result$reason == "out_of_range") {
      step_6_sort_list_dt[i, excluded := "by_date"]
    } else if (check_result$reason == "in_range") {
      step_6_sort_list_dt[i, `:=`(in_range = "yes", excluded = "no")]
    } else {
      step_6_sort_list_dt[i, `:=`(in_range = "unknown", excluded = "no")]
    }
  }
  
  # Group only the “no-date” links into pagination groups of size ≥10
  subset_idx <- which(
  step_6_sort_list_dt$excluded == "no" &
  step_6_sort_list_dt$in_range == "unknown"
  )
  
  subset_dt  <- step_6_sort_list_dt[subset_idx]
  grouped_dt <- step_6_1_grouping_func(
    step_6_1_links_dt = subset_dt,
    domain_id         = domain_id,
    domain_url        = domain_url,
    layer_1_url_id    = layer_1_url_id,
    layer_1_url       = layer_1_url,
    parent_url_id     = parent_url_id
  )
  
  step_6_sort_list_dt[subset_idx, pagination_group := grouped_dt$pagination_group]
  step_6_sort_list_dt[subset_idx, pagination_index := grouped_dt$pagination_index]
  
  # Assign sort_places for in-range links
  step_6_sort_list_dt[in_range == "yes", 
    sort_place := seq_len(.N)
  ]

  next_base <- function(dt) {
    mx <- suppressWarnings(max(dt$sort_place, na.rm = TRUE))
    if (!is.finite(mx)) 0L else mx
  }
  
  # grouped no-date links (in_range == "unknown")
   remaining_dt <- step_6_sort_list_dt[
    excluded == "no" & in_range == "unknown" &
    is.na(pagination_group)
  ]
  if (nrow(remaining_dt) > 0) {
    start <- next_base(step_6_sort_list_dt)
    step_6_sort_list_dt[link %in% remaining_dt$link,
      sort_place := start + seq_len(nrow(remaining_dt))
    ]
  }
  
  # ungrouped no-date links
  grouped_dt <- step_6_sort_list_dt[
    excluded == "no" & in_range == "unknown" &
    !is.na(pagination_group)
  ][order(pagination_group, pagination_index)]
  if (nrow(grouped_dt) > 0) {
    start <- next_base(step_6_sort_list_dt)
    step_6_sort_list_dt[link %in% grouped_dt$link,
      sort_place := start + seq_len(nrow(grouped_dt))
    ]
  }
  
  # Mark excluded links as processed
  step_6_sort_list_dt[excluded == "by_string", `:=`(
    processed = TRUE,
    processing_status = "excluded_by_string",
    sorted = "excluded"
  )]
  step_6_sort_list_dt[excluded == "by_date", `:=`(
    processed = TRUE,
    processing_status = "excluded_by_date",
    sorted = "excluded"
  )]
  
  # Mark remaining as unprocessed 
  step_6_sort_list_dt[is.na(processed), processed := FALSE]
  step_6_sort_list_dt[is.na(processing_status), processing_status := "in_progress"]
  step_6_sort_list_dt[is.na(sorted), sorted := "yes"]
  
  # updateing sorted sitemap
  parent_row_id <- get(prog_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)[current_url == parent_url, current_url_id]

  step_7_1_progression_update(
    domain_id      = domain_id,
    domain_url     = domain_url,
    layer_1_url_id = layer_1_url_id,
    layer_1_url    = layer_1_url,   
    current_url    = parent_url,    
    parent_url_id  = parent_url_id, 
    processing_status = "subsitemap_sorted",
    root_tag          = "sitemapindex",
    subsitemap_status = "in_progress",
    subsitemap_progress = paste0("0 of ", nrow(step_6_sort_list_dt)),
    sort_order       = list(step_6_sort_list_dt)
  )
  
  # child link entries
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(step_6_sort_list_dt))) {
    row <- step_6_sort_list_dt[i]
  
    step_7_1_progression_update(
      domain_id        = domain_id,
      domain_url       = domain_url,
      layer_1_url_id   = layer_1_url_id,
      layer_1_url      = layer_1_url,
      current_url      = row$link,
      parent_url_id    = parent_row_id,        
      in_range         = row$in_range,
      root_tag         = "unknown",
      sort_place       = row$sort_place,
      pagination_group = row$pagination_group,
      pagination_index = row$pagination_index,
      processed        = row$processed,
      processing_status= row$processing_status,
      sorted           = row$sorted
    )
  }
  
  return(step_6_sort_list_dt)
}
```

```{r Step 7: Defining core functions for processing sitemaps:}
# The function step_7_1_progression_update  updates the progression data table for a sitemap.
# It inserts new entries or updates existing ones, applies defaults,
# updates subsitemap_progress, and marks fully processed parents.

step_7_1_progression_update <- function(
  domain_id,
  domain_url,
  layer_1_url_id,
  layer_1_url,
  current_url,
  parent_url_id = NA_integer_,
  root_tag = "unknown",
  processed = FALSE,
  processing_status = "in_progress",
  sorted = "no",
  sort_place = NA_integer_,
  in_range = "unknown",
  subsitemap_status = "in_progress",
  sort_order = list(data.table()),
  subsitemap_progress = "in_progress",
  pagination_group = NA_character_,
  pagination_index = NA_integer_,
  pagination_group_status = NA_character_
) {
  rt <- root_tag
  step_7_progression_dt_name <- paste0("sitemap_id_", layer_1_url_id, "_progression_dt")

  # create new if not existing 
  if (!exists(step_7_progression_dt_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    assign(step_7_progression_dt_name, data.table(
      domain_id                    = integer(),
      domain_url                   = character(),
      layer_1_url_id               = integer(),
      layer_1_url                  = character(),
      current_url_id               = integer(),
      current_url                  = character(),
      parent_url_id                = integer(),
      processed                    = logical(),
      processing_status            = character(),
      sorted                       = character(),
      sort_place                   = integer(),
      in_range                     = character(),
      root_tag                     = character(),
      subsitemap_status            = character(),
      sort_order                   = list(data.table()),
      subsitemap_progress          = character(),
      pagination_group             = character(),
      pagination_index             = integer(),
      pagination_group_status      = character(),
      timestamp                    = as.POSIXct(character())
    ), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }

  step_7_progression_dt <- get(step_7_progression_dt_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  if (!"pagination_group_status" %in% colnames(step_7_progression_dt)) {
    step_7_progression_dt[, pagination_group_status := NA_character_]
  }
  existing_idx <- which(step_7_progression_dt$current_url == current_url)

  # update existing with root tag "urlset" or "unknown" 
  if (length(existing_idx) > 0) {
    new_rt <- rt
    step_7_progression_dt[existing_idx, `:=`(
      domain_id          = domain_id,
      domain_url         = domain_url,
      layer_1_url_id     = layer_1_url_id,
      layer_1_url        = layer_1_url,
      parent_url_id      = parent_url_id,
      processed          = ..processed,
      processing_status  = ..processing_status,
      sorted             = sorted,
      sort_place         = sort_place,
      in_range           = ..in_range,
      root_tag           = ifelse(step_7_progression_dt$root_tag[existing_idx] == "unknown",
                                  new_rt,
                                  step_7_progression_dt$root_tag[existing_idx]),
      
      subsitemap_status            = ifelse(rt %in% c("urlset","unknown"),
                                             "not_a_sitemap",
                                             subsitemap_status),
      
      sort_order                   = list(data.table()),
      
      subsitemap_progress          = ifelse(rt %in% c("urlset","unknown"),
                                             "not_a_sitemap",
                                             subsitemap_progress),
      
      pagination_group             = ifelse(!is.na(..pagination_group),
                                   ..pagination_group,
                                   pagination_group),
      
      pagination_index             = ifelse(!is.na(..pagination_index),
                                   ..pagination_index,
                                   pagination_index),
      
      pagination_group_status     = ifelse(!is.na(..pagination_group_status),
                                   ..pagination_group_status,
                                   pagination_group_status),
      
      timestamp                    = Sys.time()
    )]
    
    
  }
  
  if (!is.null(pagination_group_status) && length(existing_idx) > 0) {
  step_7_progression_dt[existing_idx, pagination_group_status := pagination_group_status]
}
  
  else {
    
    # add new row 
    new_id <- if (nrow(step_7_progression_dt) == 0) 1 else max(step_7_progression_dt$current_url_id, na.rm = TRUE) + 1
    step_7_new_row <- data.table(
      domain_id                    = domain_id,
      domain_url                   = domain_url,
      layer_1_url_id               = layer_1_url_id,
      layer_1_url                  = layer_1_url,
      current_url_id               = new_id,
      current_url                  = current_url,
      parent_url_id                = parent_url_id,
      processed                    = processed,
      processing_status            = processing_status,
      sorted                       = sorted,
      sort_place                   = sort_place,
      in_range                     = in_range,
      root_tag                     = rt,
      subsitemap_status            = ifelse(rt %in% c("urlset","unknown"),
                                             "not_a_sitemap",
                                             subsitemap_status),
      sort_order                   = list(data.table()),
      subsitemap_progress          = ifelse(rt %in% c("urlset","unknown"),
                                             "not_a_sitemap",
                                             subsitemap_progress),
      pagination_group             = pagination_group,
      pagination_index             = pagination_index,
      pagination_group_status      = pagination_group_status,
      timestamp                    = Sys.time()
    )
    step_7_progression_dt <- rbind(step_7_progression_dt, step_7_new_row, fill = TRUE)
  }

  ## Override if roottag "sitemapindex"
  parent_indices <- which(step_7_progression_dt$root_tag == "sitemapindex")
  status_ok  <- c("excluded_by_string","excluded_by_date","scraped","all_child_links_processed")
  status_err <- c("response_error","xml_error","unsupported_root_tag","all_processed_some_errors")

  for (p_idx in parent_indices) {
    kids  <- step_7_progression_dt[parent_url_id == step_7_progression_dt$current_url_id[p_idx]]
    stats <- kids$processing_status
    n_kids <- length(stats)
    processed_count <- sum(stats %in% c(status_ok, status_err))

      
    if (n_kids > 0 && all(stats %in% status_ok)) {
      # all childs processed & no error 
      step_7_progression_dt[p_idx, `:=`(
        processed         = TRUE,
        processing_status = "all_child_links_processed",
        subsitemap_status = "fully_processed",
        subsitemap_progress = paste0(n_kids, " of ", n_kids)
      )]
    } else if (n_kids > 0 && all(stats %in% c(status_ok, status_err))) {
      # all childs processed & at least one error 
      step_7_progression_dt[p_idx, `:=`(
        processed         = FALSE,
        processing_status = "all_processed_some_errors",
        subsitemap_status = "partially_failed",
        subsitemap_progress = paste0(processed_count, " of ", n_kids)
      )]
    } else {
      # at one child is in_progress 
      step_7_progression_dt[p_idx, `:=`(
        processed         = FALSE,
        processing_status = "in_progress",
        subsitemap_status = "in_progress",
        subsitemap_progress = paste0(processed_count, " of ", n_kids)
      )]
    }
  }

  ## Override if roottag "urlset" + in valid group
  .grp_id <- pagination_group
  err_vec <- c("response_error", "xml_error", "unsupported_root_tag")
  if (rt == "urlset" && !is.na(pagination_group)) {
  
    # pull all rows of this group
    grp_rows <- step_7_progression_dt[pagination_group == .grp_id][order(pagination_index)]
    if (!is.na(pagination_group_status) && pagination_group_status == "valid_up") {
    grp_rows <- grp_rows[order(-pagination_index)]
    
    } else {
      grp_rows <- grp_rows[order(pagination_index)]
    }
  
    # check if three in a row lay before the date range 
    status_vec <- grp_rows$pagination_group_status
    runs       <- rle(status_vec)                       # Run-Length-Encoding
    abort_now  <- any(runs$values == "date_before_range" & runs$lengths >= 3)
    
    if (abort_now) {
      abort_idx <- which(step_7_progression_dt$pagination_group == pagination_group &
                         !step_7_progression_dt$processed &
                         !step_7_progression_dt$processing_status %in% err_vec)
    
      if (length(abort_idx) > 0) {
        step_7_progression_dt[abort_idx, `:=`(
          processed               = TRUE,
          processing_status       = "excluded_by_date",
          pagination_group_status = "aborted"
        )]
      }
    }
  }
  
  # dissolve any valid_up / valid_down group that contains a SitemapIndex

  valid_grps <- unique(
    step_7_progression_dt[pagination_group_status %in% c("valid_up", "valid_down")]$pagination_group
  )
  
  for (g in valid_grps) {
    rows_g <- step_7_progression_dt[pagination_group == g]
    if (any(rows_g$root_tag == "sitemapindex")) {
  
      diss_idx <- which(step_7_progression_dt$pagination_group == g &
                        !step_7_progression_dt$processing_status %in% err_vec)
  
      if (length(diss_idx) > 0) {
        step_7_progression_dt[diss_idx, `:=`(
          processed               = FALSE,
          processing_status       = "in_progress",
          pagination_group_status = "dissolved",
          pagination_group        = NA_character_,
          pagination_index        = NA_integer_
        )]
      }
    }
  }
  
  assign(step_7_progression_dt_name, step_7_progression_dt, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

# Function: step_7_2_master_dt_update_func
# This function updates or inserts entries into the global_master_dt table.
# Status assignment logic is extended to cover new blocked/retry-related categories.

step_7_2_master_dt_update_func <- function(
  domain_id,
  domain_url,
  l1_id, 
  layer_1_url,
  request_increment = 0L,
  current_user_agent_id = NA_integer_
) {
  # Load related tables
  prog_name   <- paste0("sitemap_id_", l1_id, "_progression_dt")
  log_name    <- paste0("sitemap_id_", l1_id, "_response_log_dt")
  output_name <- paste0("sitemap_id_", l1_id, "_output_dt")
  
  progression_dt <- if (exists(prog_name, envir = .GlobalEnv))
    get(prog_name, envir = .GlobalEnv) else data.table()
  response_log_dt <- if (exists(log_name, envir = .GlobalEnv))
    get(log_name, envir = .GlobalEnv) else data.table()
  output_dt <- if (exists(output_name, envir = .GlobalEnv))
    get(output_name, envir = .GlobalEnv) else data.table()

  # Determine input_processing_status based on progression statuses
  status_vals <- unique(na.omit(progression_dt$processing_status))
  only_final <- all(status_vals %in% c("excluded_by_string", "excluded_by_date", "scraped", "all_child_links_processed", 
                                       "response_error", "xml_error", "parse_error", "unsupported_root_tag" ,"all_processed_some_errors"))
  only_error <- all(status_vals %in% c("response_error", "xml_error", "parse_error", "unsupported_root_tag"))
  has_final  <- any(status_vals %in% c("excluded_by_string", "excluded_by_date", "scraped", "all_child_links_processed"))
  has_active <- any(status_vals %in% c("in_progress", "subsitemap_sorted"))

  if (has_active) {
    input_status <- "in_progress"
  } else if (only_final) {
    input_status <- "fully_processed"
  } else if (only_error && !has_final) {
    input_status <- "total_error"
  } else {
    input_status <- "in_progress"
  }

  # Determine processing_flag from last action in response log
  if (nrow(response_log_dt) > 0) {
    actions <- na.omit(response_log_dt$action_taken)
    last_action <- if (length(actions) > 0) actions[length(actions)] else NA_character_
    processing_flag <- switch(
      last_action,
      logged              = "normal",
      soft_block_handling = "softblock",
      hard_block          = "retry",
      "normal"
    )
  } else {
    processing_flag <- "normal"
  }

  # Compute totals
  slice <- global_master_dt[layer_1_url_id == l1_id, total_request_count]

  total_requests_prior <- if (length(slice) == 0) 0L else slice[1]
  total_requests_new   <- total_requests_prior + as.integer(request_increment)
  total_urlsets        <- nrow(output_dt)

  # Update or insert master_dt row
  if (l1_id %in% global_master_dt$layer_1_url_id) {
    global_master_dt[layer_1_url_id == l1_id, `:=`(
        input_processing_status = input_status,
        total_request_count     = total_requests_new,
        total_urlsets_scraped   = total_urlsets,
        last_checked            = Sys.time(),
        current_user_agent_id   = current_user_agent_id,
        processing_flag         = processing_flag
      )]
  } else {
    global_master_dt <<- rbind(
      global_master_dt,
      data.table(
        domain_id               = domain_id,
        layer_1_url_id          = l1_id,
        layer_1_url             = layer_1_url,
        input_processing_status = input_status,
        total_request_count     = total_requests_new,
        total_urlsets_scraped   = total_urlsets,
        last_checked            = Sys.time(),
        current_user_agent_id   = current_user_agent_id,
        processing_flag         = processing_flag
      ),
      fill = TRUE
    )
  }
  
  # Checking fully processed inputs for retry flags and labeling for retry if neccessary.
  fully_processed_rows <- global_master_dt[input_processing_status == "fully_processed"]

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(fully_processed_rows))) {
    l1_id_check <- fully_processed_rows$layer_1_url_id[i]
    log_name_check <- paste0("sitemap_id_", l1_id_check, "_response_log_dt")

    if (exists(log_name_check, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      log_dt_check <- get(log_name_check, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      if ("retry_flag" %in% names(log_dt_check) && any(log_dt_check$retry_flag == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)) {
        global_master_dt[layer_1_url_id == l1_id_check, input_processing_status := "partially_processed_and_moved_to_retry"]
      }
    }
  }
  
}

# Function: step_7_3_response_log_update_func
# This function logs all non-200 HTTP responses and updates category counters and flags.
# After logging, it updates the associated progression entry and resets counters if needed.

step_7_3_response_log_update_func <- function(
  domain_id,
  domain_url,
  layer_1_url_id,
  layer_1_url,
  requested_url_id,
  requested_url,
  client_profile_id,
  http_response
) {
  # Construct the name of the response-log data.table for this sitemap
  resp_log_name <- paste0("sitemap_id_", layer_1_url_id, "_response_log_dt")

  # If the response-log table does not exist yet, create it with the required columns
  if (!exists(resp_log_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    assign(resp_log_name, data.table(
      domain_id                  = integer(),
      domain_url                 = character(),
      layer_1_url_id             = integer(),
      layer_1_url                = character(),
      requested_url_id           = integer(),
      requested_url              = character(),
      client_profile_id          = integer(),
      timestamp                  = as.POSIXct(character()),
      http_status_code           = integer(),
      http_status_message        = character(),
      response_header_snippet    = character(),
      response_body_snippet      = character(),
      response_category          = character(),
      soft_block_count_at_time   = integer(),
      hard_block_count_at_time   = integer(),
      other_error_count_at_time  = integer(),
      action_taken               = character(),
      retry_flag                 = logical()
    ), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }

  # Load the existing response-log table
  resp_log_dt <- get(resp_log_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)

  # Initialize local variables for logging
  if (is.null(http_response)) {
    # No response object → treat as hard block
    status_code     <- NA_integer_
    status_message  <- "NULL_response"
    header_snip     <- "NULL"
    body_snip       <- "NULL"
    category        <- "hard_block_indication"
  } else {
    # Extract HTTP status code
    status_code    <- httr::status_code(http_response)

    # Safely obtain a human-readable status message
    status_info    <- httr::http_status(http_response)
    status_message <- status_info$reason

    # Capture first 2000 characters of headers and body
    header_snip <- paste0(
      capture.output(str(httr::headers(http_response))),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
    header_snip <- substr(header_snip, 1, 2000)

    body_snip <- tryCatch(
      rawToChar(httr::content(http_response, as = "raw")),
      error = function(e) "ERROR_READING_BODY"
    )
    body_snip <- substr(body_snip, 1, 2000)

    # Classify response category
    if (is.na(status_code) || status_code %in% c(401, 403, 407)) {
      category <- "hard_block_indication"
    } else if (status_code %in% c(406, 408, 429, 503)) {
      category <- "soft_block_indication"
    } else {
      category <- "other_error"
    }
  }

  retry_flag_value <- if (category == "other_error") FALSE else TRUE
  
  # Retrieve previous counters from the last log entry
  prev_soft  <- 0L
  prev_hard  <- 0L
  prev_other <- 0L
  if (nrow(resp_log_dt) > 0) {
    last_cat <- tail(na.omit(resp_log_dt$response_category), 1)
    if (length(last_cat) == 1) {
      if (last_cat == "soft_block_indication") {
        prev_soft <- tail(resp_log_dt$soft_block_count_at_time, 1)
      } else if (last_cat == "hard_block_indication") {
        prev_hard <- tail(resp_log_dt$hard_block_count_at_time, 1)
      } else if (last_cat == "other_error") {
        prev_other <- tail(resp_log_dt$other_error_count_at_time, 1)
      }
    }
  }

  # Increment or reset counters based on current category
  soft_count  <- if (category == "soft_block_indication") prev_soft + 1L else 0L
  hard_count  <- if (category == "hard_block_indication") prev_hard + 1L else 0L
  other_count <- if (category == "other_error") prev_other + 1L else 0L

  # Decide action based on thresholds
  action <- "logged"
  if (soft_count > 10L) {
    action <- "soft_block_handling"
  } else if (hard_count > 10L || other_count > 10L) {
    action <- "hard_block"
  }

  # Build a new log entry
  new_entry <- data.table(
    Domain_id                  = domain_id,
    Domain_url                 = domain_url,
    Layer_1_url_id             = layer_1_url_id,
    Layer_1_url                = layer_1_url,
    requested_url_id           = requested_url_id,
    requested_url              = requested_url,
    client_profile_id          = client_profile_id,
    timestamp                  = Sys.time(),
    http_status_code           = status_code,
    http_status_message        = status_message,
    response_header_snippet    = header_snip,
    response_body_snippet      = body_snip,
    response_category          = category,
    soft_block_count_at_time   = soft_count,
    hard_block_count_at_time   = hard_count,
    other_error_count_at_time  = other_count,
    action_taken               = action,
    retry_flag                 = retry_flag_value
  )

  # Append the new entry and save back to the global environment
  resp_log_dt <- rbind(resp_log_dt, new_entry, fill = TRUE)
  assign(resp_log_name, resp_log_dt, envir = .GlobalEnv)

  # Update the progression table for this failed URL
  prog_name <- paste0("sitemap_id_", layer_1_url_id, "_progression_dt")
  if (exists(prog_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    dt  <- get(prog_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    idx <- which(dt$current_url_id == requested_url_id)
    if (length(idx) > 0) {
      data.table::set(dt, i = idx, j = "processed",         value = FALSE)
      data.table::set(dt, i = idx, j = "processing_status", value = "response_error")
    }
    assign(prog_name, dt, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }
}

# Function: step_7_4_urlset_scraper_func
# parses the XML, checks lastmod tags, and stores valid URLSETs in the output data table.
# Ensures uniqueness of urlset entries and ids.
# Updated step_7_4_urlset_scraper_func with pagination-group date_before_range logic,
# preserving existing progression values except for group-status override.
step_7_4_urlset_scraper_func <- function(
  url,
  http_response,
  xml_doc = NULL,
  global_date_start,
  global_date_end,
  domain_id,
  domain_url,
  layer_1_url_id,
  layer_1_url,
  current_url_id,
  parent_url_id
) {
  # Parse XML from response or provided doc
  if (!is.null(xml_doc)) {
    doc <- xml_doc
  } else {
    doc <- NULL
    if (grepl("\\.gz$", url, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      raw <- tryCatch(httr::content(http_response, as = "raw"), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(raw)) {
        con <- tryCatch(gzcon(rawConnection(raw, "rb")), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(con)) {
          doc <- tryCatch(xml2::read_xml(con), error = function(e) NULL)
          close(con)
        }
      }
    } else {
      txt <- tryCatch(httr::content(http_response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(txt)) {
        doc <- tryCatch(xml2::read_xml(txt), error = function(e) NULL)
      }
    }
  }

  # If parsing failed, log error and update progression
  if (is.null(doc)) {
    global_error_dt <<- rbind(
      global_error_dt,
      data.table(
        domain_id = domain_id, domain_url = domain_url,
        layer_1_url_id = layer_1_url_id, layer_1_url = layer_1_url,
        error_url_id = current_url_id, error_url = url,
        parent_url_id = parent_url_id, root_tag = "urlset",
        error_category = "xml_parse_error",
        processed_flag = FALSE, retry_flag = TRUE,
        timestamp = Sys.time(), source_function = "step_7_4_urlset_scraper_func",
        status_code = httr::status_code(http_response)
      ), fill = TRUE
    )
    step_7_1_progression_update(
      domain_id = domain_id, domain_url = domain_url,
      layer_1_url_id = layer_1_url_id, layer_1_url = layer_1_url,
      current_url = url, parent_url_id = parent_url_id,
      processed = FALSE, processing_status = "xml_error",
      in_range = "unknown", root_tag = "urlset"
    )
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Ensure root tag is <urlset>
  if (tolower(xml2::xml_name(xml2::xml_root(doc))) != "urlset") {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Normalize namespace
  ns_map <- xml2::xml_ns_rename(xml2::xml_ns(doc), d1 = "ns")

  # run date check 
  step_7_4_date_res <- step_5_1_date_check_urlset_func(
    xml_doc   = doc,
    ns_map    = ns_map,
    date_from = global_date_start,
    date_to   = global_date_end
  )
  # Extract all <lastmod> dates
  locs  <- xml2::xml_find_all(doc, ".//ns:loc", ns = ns_map)
  lastmods <- xml2::xml_find_all(doc, ".//ns:lastmod", ns = ns_map) |> xml2::xml_text()
  dates <- as.Date(gsub("T.*","", lastmods), "%Y-%m-%d")
  dates <- dates[!is.na(dates)]

  # fetch old progression values once
  prog_name <- paste0("sitemap_id_", layer_1_url_id, "_progression_dt")
  prog_dt   <- get(prog_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  old_row <- prog_dt[current_url == url][1] 
  
  # pagination‐group date_before_range check
  if (!is.na(old_row$pagination_group) && length(dates) > 0) {

  url_from  <- min(dates)
  url_to    <- max(dates)

   
    if (url_to < global_date_start) {
      step_7_1_progression_update(
        domain_id               = domain_id,
        domain_url              = domain_url,
        layer_1_url_id          = layer_1_url_id,
        layer_1_url             = layer_1_url,
        current_url             = url,
        parent_url_id           = parent_url_id,
        processed               = TRUE,                 
        processing_status       = "excluded_by_date",  
        in_range                = "no",
        root_tag                = "urlset",
        subsitemap_status       = "not_a_sitemap",
        sort_order              = list(data.table()),
        subsitemap_progress     = "not_a_sitemap",
        pagination_group        = old_row$pagination_group,
        pagination_index        = old_row$pagination_index,
        pagination_group_status = "date_before_range"
      )
      return(NULL)
    }
  }

  # Call original date-check for output
  date_info <- step_5_1_date_check_urlset_func(doc, ns_map, global_date_start, global_date_end)
  link_count <- length(xml2::xml_find_all(doc, ".//ns:loc", ns = ns_map))
  date_range <- NA_character_
  if (date_info$reason == "in_range") {
    rd <- dates[dates >= global_date_start & dates <= global_date_end]
    if (length(rd) > 0) {
      date_range <- paste0(format(min(rd), "%Y-%m-%d"), " - ", format(max(rd), "%Y-%m-%d"))
    }
  }

  # Write to output table if proceed
  if (date_info$decision == "proceed") {
    out_name <- paste0("sitemap_id_", layer_1_url_id, "_output_dt")
    if (!exists(out_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      assign(out_name, data.table(
        domain_id = integer(), domain_url = character(),
        layer_1_url_id = integer(), layer_1_url = character(),
        urlset_id = integer(), urlset_url = character(),
        in_range = character(), urlset_link_count = integer(),
        urlset_date_range = character(), urlset_content = character()
      ), envir = .GlobalEnv)
    }
    out_dt <- get(out_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    new_id <- if (nrow(out_dt)==0) 1L else max(out_dt$urlset_id)+1L
    out_dt <- rbind(out_dt, data.table(
      domain_id = domain_id, domain_url = domain_url,
      layer_1_url_id = layer_1_url_id, layer_1_url = layer_1_url,
      urlset_id = new_id, urlset_url = url,
      in_range = date_info$reason,
      urlset_link_count = link_count,
      urlset_date_range = date_range,
      urlset_content = as.character(doc)
    ), fill=TRUE)
    assign(out_name, out_dt, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }

  # Final progression update preserving original pagination_group/index
  step_7_1_progression_update(
    domain_id           = domain_id,
    domain_url          = domain_url,
    layer_1_url_id      = layer_1_url_id,
    layer_1_url         = layer_1_url,
    current_url         = url,
    parent_url_id       = parent_url_id,
    processed           = TRUE,
    processing_status   = switch(
      step_7_4_date_res$reason,
      in_range         = "scraped",
      no_lastmod_found = "scraped",
      "excluded_by_date"
    ),
    in_range            = step_7_4_date_res$reason,
    root_tag            = "urlset",
    subsitemap_status   = "not_a_sitemap",
    sort_order          = list(data.table()),
    subsitemap_progress = "not_a_sitemap",
    pagination_group    = old_row$pagination_group,
    pagination_index    = old_row$pagination_index
  )
  
  # return summary
  list(
    in_range  = (step_7_4_date_res$decision=="proceed" && step_7_4_date_res$reason=="in_range"),
    reason    = step_7_4_date_res$reason,
    link_cnt  = length(locs),
    date_span = if (length(dates)>0) paste0(min(dates)," - ",max(dates)) else NA_character_
  )
}


cat("Step 7 completed: Progression_dt updater function, response_dt updater function, master_dt updater function, urlset scraper function initialized.\n")
```

```{r Step 8: Main recursive sitemap processing function with logging}

# Actual recursive function 
step_8_recursive_processing_func <- function(next_input) {
  # get master‑row + basics
  master_row  <- global_master_dt[next_input]
  did         <- master_row$domain_id
  dur         <- master_row$domain_url
  lid         <- master_row$layer_1_url_id
  lurl        <- master_row$layer_1_url
  flag        <- master_row$processing_flag
  cur_ua_id   <- master_row$current_user_agent_id
  cur_ua_id <- global_master_dt$`current_user_agent_id`[next_input]
  if (is.na(cur_ua_id) || cur_ua_id == 0 || is.null(cur_ua_id)) {
    cur_ua_id <- 2L  
  } else {
    cur_ua_id <- (cur_ua_id %% length(global_user_agent_list)) + 1L
  }
  ua_string   <- global_user_agent_list[cur_ua_id]
  global_master_dt[next_input, current_user_agent_id := cur_ua_id]

  max_req     <- ifelse(flag == "softblock", 15L, 20L)
  sleep_delay <- ifelse(flag == "softblock", 3, 0)

  # local tables
  prog_name <- paste0("sitemap_id_", lid, "_progression_dt")
  out_name  <- paste0("sitemap_id_", lid, "_output_dt")
  log_name  <- paste0("sitemap_id_", lid, "_response_log_dt")
  prog_dt   <- get(prog_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  out_dt    <- get(out_name,  envir = .GlobalEnv)
  log_dt    <- get(log_name,  envir = .GlobalEnv)
  prog_root <- prog_dt[current_url_id == 1L]

  # initialize counters
  internal_request_counter <- 0L
  internal_error_counter   <- 0L

  ## Helper to refresh all controll structures 
  step_8_1_finish_func <- function() {
  # recalc progression (forces progress string etc.)
  if (exists(prog_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    dt  <- get(prog_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    root_idx <- which(dt$current_url == lurl & dt$parent_url_id == 0L)
    if (length(root_idx) > 0) {
      # get existing vlaues 
      proc_val   <- dt$processed[root_idx][1]
      status_val <- dt$processing_status[root_idx][1]
      in_range_val <- dt$in_range[root_idx][1]
      
      # Progression update 
      step_7_1_progression_update(
        domain_id         = did,
        domain_url        = dur,
        layer_1_url_id    = lid,
        layer_1_url       = lurl,
        current_url       = lurl,
        parent_url_id     = 0L,
        processed         = proc_val,
        processing_status = status_val, 
        in_range          = in_range_val 
      )
    }
  }

  # Master-Update
  step_7_2_master_dt_update_func(
    domain_id             = did,
    domain_url            = dur,
    l1_id                 = lid,
    layer_1_url           = lurl,
    request_increment     = internal_request_counter,
    current_user_agent_id = cur_ua_id
  )

  # Summary Print
  out_dt <- get(out_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  total_processed <- sum(prog_dt$processed, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_errors    <- sum(prog_dt$processing_status %in%
                       c("response_error", "xml_error", "unsupported_root_tag"), na.rm = TRUE)

  cat(sprintf("Requests sent to %s in this iteration: %d.\n", lurl, internal_request_counter))
  cat(sprintf("Total requests: %d.\n", global_master_dt[layer_1_url_id == lid]$total_request_count))
  cat(sprintf("Total urlsets scraped: %d.\n", nrow(out_dt)))
  cat(sprintf("Total progression entries: %d.\n", nrow(prog_dt)))
  cat(sprintf("Total links processed: %d.\n", total_processed))
  cat(sprintf("Total errors: %d.\n", total_errors))
  cat(sprintf("State of input sitemap: %s.\n", global_master_dt[layer_1_url_id == lid]$processing_flag))
  }

  ## Helper to validate groups in line 
  step_8_2_validate_pagination_group <- function(layer_1_url_id, group_id, global_date_start, global_date_end) {
  prog_name <- paste0("sitemap_id_", layer_1_url_id, "_progression_dt")
  prog_dt <- get(prog_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)

  # Identify rows belonging to this pagination group
  group_rows <- prog_dt[pagination_group == group_id]

  # Sample three URLs: first, middle, last
  sample_idx <- c(1, ceiling(nrow(group_rows) / 2), nrow(group_rows))
  detected_dates <- c()
  sample_tags <- c()
  for (i in sample_idx) {
    test_url <- group_rows$current_url[i]
    resp <- tryCatch(
      httr::GET(test_url, httr::user_agent(global_user_agent_list[2]), httr::timeout(30)),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(resp) && httr::status_code(resp) == 200L) {
      xml_doc <- tryCatch(
        xml2::read_xml(httr::content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      root_tag <- tolower(xml2::xml_name(xml2::xml_root(xml_doc)))
      sample_tags <- c(sample_tags, root_tag)
      if (root_tag == "urlset") {
        ns_map <- xml2::xml_ns_rename(xml2::xml_ns(xml_doc), d1 = "ns")
        date_res <- step_5_1_date_check_urlset_func(
          xml_doc   = xml_doc,
          ns_map    = ns_map,
          date_from = global_date_start,
          date_to   = global_date_end
        )
        
        if (root_tag == "urlset") {
        ns_map <- xml2::xml_ns_rename(xml2::xml_ns(xml_doc), d1 = "ns")
        lastmods <- xml2::xml_find_all(xml_doc, ".//ns:lastmod", ns = ns_map) |> xml2::xml_text()
        dates <- as.Date(gsub("T.*", "", lastmods), format = "%Y-%m-%d")
        dates <- dates[!is.na(dates)]
        
        if (length(dates) > 0) {
          detected_dates <- c(detected_dates, min(dates))  
        
        } else {
          cat(sprintf("%s No valid last mod tags found in sample request.\n", test_url))
        }
      }
      }
    }
  }

  # If any sample is not a urlset, dissolve group
  if (!(length(sample_tags) == 3 && all(sample_tags == "urlset"))) {
    for (url in group_rows$current_url) {
      step_7_1_progression_update(
        domain_id                = group_rows$domain_id[1],
        domain_url               = group_rows$domain_url[1],
        layer_1_url_id           = layer_1_url_id,
        layer_1_url              = group_rows$layer_1_url[1],
        current_url              = url,
        parent_url_id            = group_rows$parent_url_id[1],
        pagination_group         = NA_character_,
        pagination_index         = NA_integer_,
        pagination_group_status  = "invalid_urlsets"
      )
    }
    return(FALSE)
  }

  # Check if dates are monotonic within 2-day tolerance
  is_up   <- all(detected_dates[-1] >= detected_dates[-length(detected_dates)] - 2)
  is_down <- all(detected_dates[-1] <= detected_dates[-length(detected_dates)] + 2)
  status_to_set <- if (is_up) "valid_up" else if (is_down) "valid_down" else "invalid"

  # Apply status updates for entire group
  for (url in group_rows$current_url) {
    if (status_to_set == "invalid") {
      step_7_1_progression_update(
        domain_id               = group_rows$domain_id[1],
        domain_url              = group_rows$domain_url[1],
        layer_1_url_id          = layer_1_url_id,
        layer_1_url             = group_rows$layer_1_url[1],
        current_url             = url,
        parent_url_id           = group_rows$parent_url_id[1],
        pagination_group_status = "invalid",
        pagination_group        = NA_character_,
        pagination_index        = NA_integer_
      )
    } else {
      step_7_1_progression_update(
        domain_id               = group_rows$domain_id[1],
        domain_url              = group_rows$domain_url[1],
        layer_1_url_id          = layer_1_url_id,
        layer_1_url             = group_rows$layer_1_url[1],
        current_url             = url,
        parent_url_id           = group_rows$parent_url_id[1],
        pagination_group_status = status_to_set
      )
    }
  }
  return(status_to_set %in% c("valid_up", "valid_down"))
}

  # recursion 
  repeat {
     
    # abort check
    if (internal_request_counter >= max_req || internal_error_counter >= 5L) {
      step_8_1_finish_func(); break
    }
    
    # check for "candidate" groups 
    candidate_groups <- unique(prog_dt[pagination_group_status == "candidate"]$pagination_group)
    for (g in candidate_groups) {
      step_8_2_validate_pagination_group(layer_1_url_id = lid,
                                 group_id = g,
                                 global_date_start = global_date_start,
                                 global_date_end = global_date_end)
      internal_request_counter <- internal_request_counter + 3L
    }
    
    # reload progression each loop
    prog_dt <- get(prog_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    if (!"pagination_group_status" %in% colnames(prog_dt)) {
      prog_dt[, pagination_group_status := NA_character_]
      assign(prog_name, prog_dt, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    }
    
    # filter out errors 
    valid_dt <- prog_dt[
      !processing_status %in% c("xml_error", "response_error", "unsupported_root_tag") &
      processed == FALSE &
      (is.na(root_tag) | root_tag == "unknown")
    ]
    
    # first: no pagination
    group_a <- valid_dt[is.na(pagination_group) & is.na(pagination_index)]
    if (nrow(group_a) > 0) {
      next_row <- group_a[order(parent_url_id, sort_place, current_url_id)][1]
    } else {
      # then: paginated
      group_b <- valid_dt[!is.na(pagination_group) & !is.na(pagination_index)]
      if (nrow(group_b) > 0) {
        next_row <- group_b[
          order(parent_url_id, pagination_group, pagination_index, current_url_id)
        ][1]
      } else {
        next_row <- NULL
      }
    }
    
    # break if all done 
    if (is.null(next_row) || nrow(next_row) == 0) {
      step_8_1_finish_func()
      break
    }
    
    # GET request
    resp <- tryCatch(
      httr::GET(next_row$current_url,
                httr::user_agent(ua_string),
                httr::timeout(30)),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    internal_request_counter <- internal_request_counter + 1L

    Sys.sleep(sleep_delay)

    # response handling 
    if (!is.null(resp) && httr::status_code(resp) == 200L) {
      # reset block counters in response_log
      if (exists(log_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
        tmp_log <- get(log_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
        tmp_log[, c(
          "soft_block_count_at_time",
          "hard_block_count_at_time",
          "other_error_count_at_time"
        ) := .(0L, 0L, 0L)]
        assign(log_name, tmp_log, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      }
      internal_error_counter <- 0L
    } else {
      # non‑200
      step_7_3_response_log_update_func(
        domain_id         = did,
        domain_url        = dur,
        layer_1_url_id    = lid,
        layer_1_url       = lurl,
        requested_url_id  = next_row$current_url_id,
        requested_url     = next_row$current_url,
        client_profile_id = cur_ua_id,
        http_response     = resp
      )
      # progression flag
      step_7_1_progression_update(
        domain_id         = did, domain_url = dur,
        layer_1_url_id    = lid, layer_1_url = lurl,
        current_url       = next_row$current_url,
        parent_url_id     = next_row$parent_url_id,
        processed         = FALSE,
        processing_status = "response_error"
      )
      internal_error_counter <- internal_error_counter + 1L
      cat(sprintf(
        "Error response for link: %s. \n Status code %s. \n Entry in response_log made.\n",
        next_row$current_url,
        ifelse(is.null(resp), "NULL", httr::status_code(resp))
      ))
      next
    }
  
    # gz handling
    xml_doc <- NULL
    
    if (grepl("\\.gz$", next_row$current_url, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      # 1) raw data as vector
      raw_data <- tryCatch(httr::content(resp, as = "raw"),
                           error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(raw_data)) {
        # 2) unapck binary
        con_gz <- tryCatch(gzcon(rawConnection(raw_data, "rb")),
                           error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(con_gz)) {
          # 3) parse connection
          xml_doc <- tryCatch(xml2::read_xml(con_gz),
                              error = function(e) NULL)
          close(con_gz)
        }
      }
    } else {
      # normal xml
      xml_text <- tryCatch(httr::content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"),
                           error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(xml_text)) {
        xml_doc <- tryCatch(xml2::read_xml(xml_text),
                            error = function(e) NULL)
      }
    }
    
    if (is.null(xml_doc)) {
      # parse error
      global_error_dt <<- rbind(
        global_error_dt,
        data.table::data.table(
          domain_id = did, domain_url = dur,
          layer_1_url_id = lid, layer_1_url = lurl,
          error_url_id = next_row$current_url_id,
          error_url = next_row$current_url,
          parent_url_id = next_row$parent_url_id,
          root_tag = NA_character_,
          error_category = "xml_parse_error",
          processed_flag = FALSE,
          retry_flag = TRUE,
          timestamp = Sys.time(),
          source_function = "step_8_recursive_processing_func",
          status_code = httr::status_code(resp)
        ),
        fill = TRUE
      )
      step_7_1_progression_update(
        domain_id = did, domain_url = dur,
        layer_1_url_id = lid, layer_1_url = lurl,
        current_url = next_row$current_url,
        parent_url_id = next_row$parent_url_id,
        processed = FALSE,
        processing_status = "xml_error"
      )
      cat(sprintf(
        "Error in link %s. Link moved to error_dt, reason: parse_error.\n",
        next_row$current_url
      ))
      next
    }

    # root tag routing
    rtag <- tolower(xml2::xml_name(xml2::xml_root(xml_doc)))
    if (!rtag %in% c("urlset", "sitemapindex", "sitemap")) {
      global_error_dt <<- rbind(
        global_error_dt,
        data.table::data.table(
          domain_id = did, domain_url = dur,
          layer_1_url_id = lid, layer_1_url = lurl,
          error_url_id = next_row$current_url_id,
          error_url = next_row$current_url,
          parent_url_id = next_row$parent_url_id,
          root_tag = rtag,
          error_category = "unsupported_root_tag",
          processed_flag = FALSE,
          retry_flag = TRUE,
          timestamp = Sys.time(),
          source_function = "step_8_recursive_processing_func",
          status_code = httr::status_code(resp)
        ),
        fill = TRUE
      )
      step_7_1_progression_update(
        domain_id = did, domain_url = dur,
        layer_1_url_id = lid, layer_1_url = lurl,
        current_url = next_row$current_url,
        parent_url_id = next_row$parent_url_id,
        processed = FALSE,
        processing_status = "unsupported_root_tag"
      )
      cat(sprintf(
        "Error in link %s. Link moved to error_dt, reason: unsupported_root_tag.\n",
        next_row$current_url
      ))
      next
    }

    if (rtag == "urlset") {
    # call urlset scraping function 
    step_7_4_res <- step_7_4_urlset_scraper_func(
      url               = next_row$current_url,
      http_response     = resp,
      xml_doc           = xml_doc,
      global_date_start = global_date_start,
      global_date_end   = global_date_end,
      domain_id         = did,
      domain_url        = dur,
      layer_1_url_id    = lid,
      layer_1_url       = lurl,
      current_url_id    = next_row$current_url_id,
      parent_url_id     = next_row$parent_url_id
    )
  
    } else if (rtag == "sitemapindex") {
      # collect child links
      ns_map <- xml2::xml_ns_rename(xml2::xml_ns(xml_doc), d1 = "ns")
      child_links <- xml2::xml_find_all(xml_doc, ".//ns:loc",
                                        ns = ns_map) %>% xml2::xml_text()

      sort_dt <- step_6_sorting_func(
        step_6_links_vector       = child_links,
        layer_1_url_id            = lid,
        layer_1_url               = lurl,  
        parent_url                = next_row$current_url,
        parent_url_id             = next_row$current_url_id,
        global_date_start         = global_date_start,
        global_date_end           = global_date_end,
        global_excluded_strings   = global_excluded_strings,
        domain_id                 = did,
        domain_url                = dur
      )
      
      step_7_1_progression_update(
        domain_id         = did,      domain_url  = dur,
        layer_1_url_id    = lid,      layer_1_url = lurl,
        current_url       = next_row$current_url,
        parent_url_id     = next_row$parent_url_id,
        processed         = FALSE,
        processing_status = "subsitemap_sorted",
        root_tag          = "sitemapindex",
        subsitemap_status = "in_progress"
      )

      # summary print 
      n_total <- nrow(sort_dt)
      n_valid <- sum(sort_dt$sorted == "yes")
      n_ruled <- n_total - n_valid
      
      cat(sprintf("Sub-sitemap URL: %s \n", next_row$current_url))
      cat(sprintf("Total links detected on subsitemap: %d \n", n_total))
      cat(sprintf("Excluded links: %d \n", n_ruled))
      cat(sprintf("Valid links: %d \n", n_valid))
    }
  }
}


cat("Step 8 completed: Recursive sitemap processing function defined.\n")
```

```{r Step 9: Defining the Master Loop }
# Define a master loop that processes all pending entries until completion
step_9_master_loop_func <- function() {
  step_9_iter_count <- 0L
  
  repeat {
    # Identify indices still in progress
    step_9_pending_idx <- which(
      ! global_master_dt$input_processing_status %in% 
        c("partially_processed_and_moved_to_retry", "fully_processed", "total_error")
    )
    
    # Exit loop when no pending entries remain
    if (length(step_9_pending_idx) == 0L) break
    
    step_9_iter_count <- step_9_iter_count + 1L
    
    # Process each pending entry, catching errors to avoid aborting
    for (step_9_idx in step_9_pending_idx) {
      tryCatch(
        {
          step_8_recursive_processing_func(next_input = step_9_idx)
        },
        error = function(e) {
          message(
            "Error in iteration ", step_9_iter_count, 
            " for index ", step_9_idx, ": ", e$message
          )
        }
      )
    }
    
    # Compute counts of each status
    step_9_fully_count     <- sum(global_master_dt$input_processing_status == "fully_processed")
    step_9_partial_count  <- sum(global_master_dt$input_processing_status == "partially_processed_and_moved_to_retry")
    step_9_total_count    <- sum(global_master_dt$input_processing_status == "total_error")
    step_9_progress_count <- sum(global_master_dt$input_processing_status == "in_progress")
    
    # Print status summary
    message(step_9_fully_count,     " entries fully processed")
    message(step_9_partial_count,   " entries had partial errors and were moved to retry")
    message(step_9_total_count,     " entries had total errors")
    message(step_9_progress_count,  " entries still being processed")
  }
  
  # Final summary when loop ends
  message("Master loop ends after ", step_9_iter_count, " iterations.")
  message(step_9_fully_count,    " entries fully processed")
  message(step_9_partial_count,  " entries had partial errors and were moved to retry")
  message(step_9_total_count,    " entries had total errors")
}


cat("Step 9 completed: Master loop defined. \n")

```



```{r Step 10: Preparing the Input, initializing progression structures}
# Step 10: Preparing the Input, initializing progression structures
step_10_input_dt <- step_2_input_dt  

# Exclude by string patterns
step_10_string_excluded_dt <- step_10_input_dt %>%
  filter(str_detect(layer_1_url, paste(global_excluded_strings, collapse = "|"))) %>%
  mutate(
    excluded_url_id = as.integer(layer_1_url_id),
    excluded_url    = layer_1_url,
    reason          = "excluded_by_string"
  )

# date-based filtering for remaining
step_10_remaining_dt <- step_10_input_dt %>%
  anti_join(step_10_string_excluded_dt, by = "layer_1_url_id") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    date_res    = list(step_5_2_date_check_link_func(layer_1_url, global_date_start, global_date_end)),
    date_reason = date_res$reason
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

step_10_date_excluded_dt <- step_10_remaining_dt %>%
  filter(date_reason == "out_of_range") %>%
  mutate(
    excluded_url_id = as.integer(layer_1_url_id),
    excluded_url    = layer_1_url,
    reason          = "excluded_by_date"
  )

# log all exclusions into global_error_dt
global_error_dt <- rbind(
  global_error_dt,
  step_10_string_excluded_dt %>%
    transmute(
      domain_id       = domain_id,
      domain_url      = domain_url,
      layer_1_url_id  = layer_1_url_id,
      layer_1_url     = layer_1_url,
      error_url_id    = excluded_url_id,
      error_url       = excluded_url,
      parent_url_id   = 0L,
      root_tag        = "unknown",
      error_category  = "excluded_string",
      processed_flag  = TRUE,
      retry_flag      = FALSE,
      timestamp       = Sys.time(),
      source_function = "code_chunk_10",
      status_code     = NA_integer_
    ),
  step_10_date_excluded_dt %>%
    transmute(
      domain_id       = domain_id,
      domain_url      = domain_url,
      layer_1_url_id  = layer_1_url_id,
      layer_1_url     = layer_1_url,
      error_url_id    = excluded_url_id,
      error_url       = excluded_url,
      parent_url_id   = 0L,
      root_tag        = "unknown",
      error_category  = "input_out_of_range",
      processed_flag  = TRUE,
      retry_flag      = FALSE,
      timestamp       = Sys.time(),
      source_function = "code_chunk_10",
      status_code     = NA_integer_
    ),
  fill = TRUE
)

# prepare cleaned input table
step_10_clean_input_dt <- step_10_remaining_dt %>%
  filter(date_reason != "out_of_range") %>%
  select(domain_id, domain_url, layer_1_url_id, layer_1_url) %>%
  mutate(
    domain_id       = row_number(),
    layer_1_url_id  = row_number()
  )

# initialize individual progression / output / response tables and master entries
for (i in seq_len(nrow(step_10_clean_input_dt))) {
  did <- step_10_clean_input_dt$domain_id[i]
  dur <- step_10_clean_input_dt$domain_url[i]
  lid <- step_10_clean_input_dt$layer_1_url_id[i]
  url <- step_10_clean_input_dt$layer_1_url[i]

  prog_name <- paste0("sitemap_id_", lid, "_progression_dt")
  out_name  <- paste0("sitemap_id_", lid, "_output_dt")
  log_name  <- paste0("sitemap_id_", lid, "_response_log_dt")

  assign(prog_name, data.table(), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(out_name,  data.table(), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(log_name,  data.table(), envir = .GlobalEnv)

  root_entry <- data.table(
    domain_id                    = did,
    domain_url                   = dur,
    layer_1_url_id               = lid,
    layer_1_url                  = url,
    current_url_id               = 1L,
    current_url                  = url,
    parent_url_id                = 0L,
    processed                    = FALSE,
    processing_status            = "in_progress",
    sorted                       = "no",
    sort_place                   = NA_integer_,
    in_range                     = NA_character_,
    root_tag                     = "unknown",
    subsitemap_status            = NA_character_,
    sort_order                   = list(data.table()),
    subsitemap_progress          = NA_character_,
    pagination_group             = NA_character_,
    pagination_index             = NA_integer_,
    pagination_group_status      = NA_character_,
    timestamp                    = Sys.time()
  )
  assign(prog_name,
         rbind(get(prog_name, envir = .GlobalEnv), root_entry, fill = TRUE),
         envir = .GlobalEnv)

  global_master_dt <<- rbind(
    global_master_dt,
    data.table(
      domain_id               = did,
      domain_url              = dur,
      layer_1_url_id          = lid,
      layer_1_url             = url,
      input_processing_status = "in_progress",
      total_request_count     = 0L,
      total_urlsets_scraped   = 0L,
      last_checked            = Sys.time(),
      current_user_agent_id   = 0L,
      processing_flag         = "normal"
    ),
    fill = TRUE
  )
}
  
  # remove intermediate data tables
  rm(step_10_input_dt,
   step_10_string_excluded_dt,
   step_10_remaining_dt,
   step_10_date_excluded_dt,
   root_entry)


cat("Step 10 completed: individual progression, output and response tables initialized, master_dt updated.\n")
```

```{r Step 12: Wrangling and saving outputs, generating retry_progression_dts}
# Step 12: Wrangle Outputs and Save
# This chunk removes the "sort_order" column, collects excluded-by-string errors,
# cleans empty logs, builds retry tables, and saves all relevant objects.
step_12_wrangle_and_save_func <- function() {
  # 1. Remove "sort_order" from all progression tables
  prog_names <- ls(envir = .GlobalEnv, pattern = "^sitemap_id_[0-9]+_progression_dt$")
  for (nm in prog_names) {
    dt <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    if ("sort_order" %in% names(dt)) {
      dt[, sort_order := NULL]
    }
    assign(nm, dt, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }

  # 2. Collect "excluded_by_string" entries into global_error_dt
  for (nm in prog_names) {
    dt   <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    excl <- dt[processing_status == "excluded_by_string", ]
    if (nrow(excl) > 0L) {
      start_id <- nrow(global_error_dt) + 1L
      new_ids  <- seq(start_id, length.out = nrow(excl))
      err_dt <- data.table(
        domain_id       = excl$domain_id,
        domain_url      = excl$domain_url,
        layer_1_url_id  = excl$layer_1_url_id,
        layer_1_url     = excl$layer_1_url,
        error_url_id    = new_ids,
        error_url       = excl$current_url,
        parent_url_id   = excl$parent_url_id,
        root_tag        = excl$root_tag,
        error_category  = "excluded_string",
        processed_flag  = TRUE,
        retry_flag      = FALSE,
        timestamp       = excl$timestamp,
        status_code     = excl$status_code,
        source_function = "step_8"
      )
      global_error_dt <<- unique(rbind(global_error_dt, err_dt, fill = TRUE))
    }
  }

  # 3. Remove empty response-log tables
  resp_names <- ls(envir = .GlobalEnv, pattern = "^sitemap_id_[0-9]+_response_log_dt$")
  for (nm in resp_names) {
    dt <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    if (nrow(dt) == 0L) {
      rm(list = nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    }
  }

  # 4. Build retry_master_dt
  retry_master_dt <<- copy(global_master_dt[input_processing_status == "partially_processed_and_moved_to_retry"])
  if (nrow(retry_master_dt) > 0L) {
    retry_master_dt[, `:=`(
      input_processing_status = "in_progress",
      total_request_count     = 0L,
      total_urlsets_scraped   = 0L,
      current_user_agent_id   = 0L,
      last_checked            = as.POSIXct(NA),
      processing_flag         = "normal"
    )]
  }

  # 5. Create retry progression tables
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(retry_master_dt))) {
    lid    <- retry_master_dt$layer_1_url_id[i]
    resp_nm <- paste0("sitemap_id_", lid, "_response_log_dt")
    if (!exists(resp_nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) next
    resp_dt <- get(resp_nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)[retry_flag == TRUE]
    if (nrow(resp_dt) == 0L) next

    retry_prog_nm <- paste0("sitemap_id_", lid, "_retry_progression_dt")
    cols <- c(
      "domain_id","domain_url","layer_1_url_id","layer_1_url",
      "current_url_id","current_url","parent_url_id","processed",
      "processing_status","sorted","sort_place","in_range",
      "root_tag","subsitemap_status","subsitemap_progress",
      "pagination_group","pagination_index","pagination_group_status",
      "timestamp",
      "http_status_code","http_status_message",
      "response_header_snippet","response_body_snippet",
      "response_category","action_taken"
    )
    
    out_dt <- data.table(
      domain_id = integer(),
      domain_url = character(),
      layer_1_url_id = integer(),
      layer_1_url = character(),
      current_url_id = integer(),
      current_url = character(),
      parent_url_id = integer(),
      processed = logical(),
      processing_status = character(),
      sorted = character(),
      sort_place = integer(),
      in_range = character(),
      root_tag = character(),
      subsitemap_status = character(),
      subsitemap_progress = character(),
      pagination_group = character(),
      pagination_index = integer(),
      pagination_group_status = character(),
      timestamp = as.POSIXct(character()),
      http_status_code = integer(),
      http_status_message = character(),
      response_header_snippet = character(),
      response_body_snippet = character(),
      response_category = character(),
      action_taken = character()
    )
    
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(resp_dt))) {
      r <- resp_dt[j]
      row <- data.table(
        domain_id               = r$Domain_id,
        domain_url              = r$Domain_url,
        layer_1_url_id          = r$Layer_1_url_id,
        layer_1_url             = r$Layer_1_url,
        current_url_id          = r$requested_url_id,
        current_url             = r$requested_url,
        parent_url_id           = NA_integer_,
        processed               = FALSE,
        processing_status       = "in_progress",
        sorted                  = "no",
        sort_place              = NA_integer_,
        in_range                = NA_character_,
        root_tag                = "unknown",
        subsitemap_status       = NA_character_,
        subsitemap_progress     = NA_character_,
        pagination_group        = NA_character_,
        pagination_index        = NA_integer_,
        pagination_group_status = NA_character_,
        timestamp               = r$timestamp,
        http_status_code        = r$http_status_code,
        http_status_message     = r$http_status_message,
        response_header_snippet = r$response_header_snippet,
        response_body_snippet   = r$response_body_snippet,
        response_category       = r$response_category,
        action_taken            = r$action_taken
      )
      out_dt <- rbind(out_dt, row, fill = TRUE)
    }
    assign(retry_prog_nm, out_dt, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }

  # 6. Save all objects as .rds
  save_list <- c(
    ls(envir = .GlobalEnv, pattern = "^sitemap_id_[0-9]+_progression_dt$"),
    ls(envir = .GlobalEnv, pattern = "^sitemap_id_[0-9]+_output_dt$"),
    ls(envir = .GlobalEnv, pattern = "^sitemap_id_[0-9]+_response_log_dt$"),
    ls(envir = .GlobalEnv, pattern = "^sitemap_id_[0-9]+_retry_progression_dt$"),
    "global_master_dt","global_error_dt"
  )
  for (nm in save_list) {
    obj <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    saveRDS(obj, file = file.path(step_1_output_folder, paste0(nm, ".rds")))
  }
}

step_12_wrangle_and_save_func()


cat("Step 12 completed: All date cleaned and saved.\n")
```
